overview.summary: BillsGenesis is an enterprise-grade, zero-allocation Unity framework focusing on Service Locator pattern, lightweight DI, and extreme devex. Designed to replace legacy frameworks like Zenject or VContainer in production.
core_principles: Zero boilerplate – just use [Inject] or Genesis.Get<T>()
Performance first – priority queue timer, object pooling, auto cleanup
Developer happiness – beautiful dashboard, live monitor, auto boot
Mobile-first – lightweight, encrypted storage, haptic, smooth loading

modules.name: Genesis Core
modules.description: Kernel of the framework. Manages service registration, DI, and application lifecycle.
best_practices: Use [Inject] instead of calling Genesis.Get<T>() in Update loops.
Avoid heavy logic in InitializeAsync(), move it to OnAppReady().
troubleshooting: 'Service not found': Check if class has [ServiceConfig] attribute.
'Circular Dependency': Two services inject each other in Initialize. Move to OnAppReady.

api.description: Get singleton instance of a registered service.
Manually register a service at runtime.
Trigger manual DI for pure C# objects.
api.example: public class Data { [Inject] StorageManager s; public Data() => Genesis.InjectDependencies(this); }

modules.name: Bootstrapper & Auto Boot
modules.description: System to auto-launch the framework from any scene. No need to manually open _Bootstrap.
best_practices: Remove legacy code like [RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod].
Keep only one _Bootstrap scene in the project.
Place _Bootstrap at index 0 in Build Settings.
troubleshooting: Black screen? → Check if _Bootstrap is in Build Settings.
Service null? → Check if service prefab is in Manifest.

modules.name: Genesis Manifest
modules.description: Configuration heart. Manages Global Services and Scene Groups.
best_practices: Always put _Bootstrap in the first Group.
Use Additive Scenes for UI_Global, Audio, Environment_Common.
Global Services only accept prefabs with components inheriting GenesisSingletonService.

modules.name: Audio Manager
modules.description: Audio system supporting BGM cross-fading, SFX pooling, and AudioMixer.
best_practices: Use PlaySfx for UI sounds, PlaySfx3D for gameplay.
Call PauseAll(true) when showing ads or pausing game.

api.signature: PlayMusic(AudioClip clip, float fade, bool loop)
api.description: Smoothly transition background music with cross-fade.

api.signature: PlaySfx(AudioClip clip, float volume, float pitch)
api.description: Play 2D sound (UI) via pool.
Toggle all audio (for Settings Mute button).

modules.name: Signal Hub
modules.description: Event Bus using Structs for loose coupling and zero-allocation.
best_practices: Declare Signals as structs to avoid GC.
Always Dispose subscription when object is destroyed.
Use Sticky Signal for game states (Pause, GameOver).

api.description: Listen for a signal. Returns IDisposable.
Listen for a signal exactly once, then auto-unsubscribe.

modules.name: Pool Manager
modules.description: High-performance Object Pooling system for GameObjects.
best_practices: Always use Despawn() instead of Destroy().
Implement IPoolable on Prefabs to catch OnSpawn/OnDespawn events.
Call DespawnAll() when reloading scenes.

api.signature: Spawn(GameObject prefab, Vector3 pos, Quaternion rot)
api.description: Get object from pool.
Return object to pool.
Recall ALL active objects to pool. Use on Restart.
Completely clear a pool (use when changing chapters to free memory).

modules.name: Storage Manager
modules.description: Secure storage (AES Encryption) and PlayerPrefs wrapper.
best_practices: Use SaveAsync for large data (Inventory, UserProfile).
Use const strings for PlayerPrefs keys.

modules.name: Scene Manager
modules.description: Manages transitions, loading screens, and Scene Groups.
best_practices: Use LoadSceneGroup for environment + UI.
Use ReloadCurrentScene for quick level replay.

Use SmartSliceLoading shader for smooth fill effects.

overview.summary: BillsGenesis là một framework Unity enterprise-grade, zero-allocation, tập trung vào Service Locator, DI nhẹ và devex cực cao. Được thiết kế để thay thế hoàn toàn các framework cũ như Zenject, VContainer trong dự án thực chiến.
core_principles: Zero boilerplate – chỉ cần [Inject] hoặc Genesis.Get<T>()
Performance first – priority queue timer, object pooling, auto cleanup
Developer happiness – dashboard đẹp, live monitor, auto boot
Mobile-first – lightweight, encrypted storage, haptic, loading mượt

modules.name: Genesis Core
modules.description: Kernel của framework. Quản lý việc đăng ký service, DI và vòng đời ứng dụng.
best_practices: Sử dụng [Inject] thay vì gọi Genesis.Get<T>() trong Update loop.
Tránh logic nặng trong InitializeAsync(), hãy dời sang OnAppReady().
troubleshooting: Lỗi 'Service not found': Kiểm tra xem class đã có attribute [ServiceConfig] chưa.
Lỗi 'Circular Dependency': Hai service inject lẫn nhau trong Initialize. Hãy chuyển sang OnAppReady.

api.description: Lấy instance singleton của service đã đăng ký.
Đăng ký thủ công một service tại runtime.
Kích hoạt DI thủ công cho object thuần C# (không phải MonoBehaviour).
api.example: public class Data { [Inject] StorageManager s; public Data() => Genesis.InjectDependencies(this); }

modules.name: Bootstrapper & Auto Boot
modules.description: Hệ thống tự động khởi chạy framework dù bạn Play ở bất kỳ scene nào. Không cần nhớ mở scene _Bootstrap.
best_practices: Xóa hết code cũ kiểu [RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod].
Chỉ cần duy nhất 1 scene _Bootstrap trong project.
Để _Bootstrap ở index 0 trong Build Settings.
troubleshooting: Màn hình đen? → Kiểm tra _Bootstrap đã add vào Build Settings chưa.
Service null? → Kiểm tra prefab service đã kéo vào Manifest chưa.

modules.name: Genesis Manifest

best_practices: Luôn đặt _Bootstrap ở Group đầu tiên.
Dùng Additive Scenes cho UI_Global, Audio, Environment_Common.
Global Services chỉ chấp nhận prefab có component kế thừa GenesisSingletonService.

modules.name: Audio Manager

best_practices: Dùng PlaySfx cho UI sound, PlaySfx3D cho gameplay.
